A letter from your husband

My dearest JaanPakhi

My JaanPakhi, my Phool…

Happy Birthday to the woman who makes my life more beautiful just by being in it. 💗

This birthday is so special to me, because it is the first birthday of yours in our married life. I wish I could gather every flower, every shining star and every gentle breeze in the world and lay them at your feet, yet even all of them together could never match the beauty you bring into my life.

You are not simply my wife. You are my peace after a long day, my smile in a hard moment, my favourite thought, and the home my heart will always return to. I call you my JaanPakhi, the little bird that sings inside my heart, and my Phool, because you make even ordinary days bloom.

My prayer is that Allah fills your life with good health, endless happiness, peace, success, and countless reasons to smile. May I always protect your heart, respect your dreams, make you laugh, and love you more thoughtfully with every passing year.

Today, tomorrow, and in every chapter still waiting for us, I choose you, JaanPakhi. In every season, in every storm, in every small ordinary moment, we are a team, and you are my forever.

Happy Birthday, my lifeline. May your beautiful heart always feel how deeply it is loved. 🌹

Forever Yours,
Mr. Husband, Rahat
